[[sn:Three prophets]][[Category:Three Prophets]]
The three prophets are a set of three prophets who each addressed a different [[triad]] of [[Nine plagues|plagues]].

* [[Jesus]] [[Domicide]]
* [[The Buddha|Buddha]] [[Foolishness]]
* [[Mani]] [[Enstuckment|Entrapment]]

== Omitted prophets ==
[[Zarathustra]] and [[Muhammad]] are omitted from the list. This is not because they are seen as lesser, but rather that they are not seen as offering anything unique. Muhammad addresses domicide arguably better than Jesus, but is less well known. Zarathustra is in a similar situation but his specialty isn't as clear either.
